ruleDefinitions.name: (Audit) Log Deletion Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects deletion or truncation of Linux log files located in /var/log. Attackers may attempt to remove or clear log files to hide malicious activity, including unauthorized access, privilege escalation, or persistence mechanisms

sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND platform:"Unix"
AND process_name:("rm","truncate")
AND process_command_line:("/var/log/")
AND NOT process_command_line:(" -mtime "," -mmin ",".gz")
AND NOT parent_process_name:("logrotate","cron","systemd","logrotate-script")
